subject: alt-ft
title: ALT.FT.-----PRI.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 401 (R(AS)CM(II)-45). ALT-FT (alternative functionalism) is the subject; PRI-INFO (principle information) is the partner. From the subject: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", PER-TRS (perceived transition) and ACC-DY (accelerated dynamics). From INTR: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From PER-TRS: ACT (activism). From ACC-DY: SF-RZ (self-realization). From AF-DY: AFI (affinity insight). From AFI: PART (participation).
